description: Only used by `just outdated` (in ansible/), which runs Renovate read-only to list newer versions.
No bot, no pull requests. See ansible/README.md, 'Update service images'.

customManagers.description: A '# renovate: datasource=docker depName=<image>' comment above any '<name>_version:' key in a role's defaults/main.yml
